items.title: Saks Wins Approval to Exit Bankruptcy After Reorganising
items.excerpt: Under Saks Global’s plan, which US bankruptcy judge Alfredo Perez called ‘an extraordinary result,’ the company will reduce its funded debt from $3.4 billion to about $1.2 billion.

items.title: Astronauts return to ISS after sheltering during air leak repair attempt
items.excerpt: Russian attempt to repair tunnel area sparks safe-haven procedure for five other astronauts onboard.

items.title: A Sherpa Survived 6 Days Alone on Everest. His Family Says He Was Abandoned.
items.excerpt: Dawa Sherpa, 57, was found alive on Thursday, nearly a week after he was last seen on the mountain. His wife says more could have been done to find him sooner.

items.title: America’s K-Shaped Market May Not Be What It Seems
items.excerpt: The recent success of retailers from Coach to Zara may be powered by the surprising resilience of America’s middle class, many of whom have moved up, not down, the economic ladder.

items.title: Everest guide survived six-day ordeal by eating chocolate and 'chewing ice'
items.excerpt: Dawa Sherpa was spotted alive by a cleaning crew as he slid slowly down the world's tallest mountain and spoke to the BBC from hospital.

items.title: Iran’s Soccer Team Allowed Into U.S. for World Cup, but Many Staff Denied
items.excerpt: After months of doubts over their participation, Iran’s players have received visas for the United States just days before the World Cup begins.

items.title: The BoF Podcast | Conner Ives Is Building a Business With Instinct
items.excerpt: From Central Saint Martins to the viral success of “Protect The Dolls,” Conner Ives joins Imran Amed to discuss what it takes to build an independent fashion label in today’s frac…

items.title: Putin says there is 'no point' meeting Zelensky over ending Ukraine war
items.excerpt: The Russian president's refusal comes after his Ukrainian counterpart wrote an open letter calling for face-to-face talks.

items.title: Pamela Hicks, Lady-in-Waiting to Elizabeth II of Britain, Dies at 97
items.excerpt: The queen’s third cousin, she was a bridesmaid at the royal wedding in 1947, and witnessed firsthand pivotal moments in British history.
